items.summary: Recommendation: reject production and monetization work for blackmarketapparel.com pending stronger attributable evidence; retain only a bounded public reachability check to distinguish the compliance probe failure from an actual outage. The site has only 6 sessions and 2 conversions, no supplied site-level revenue, and compliance status is unknown due to fetch failure. Decision question: should the owner authorize this single read-only public check?
